name: ai-perplexity-clone
description: Full-stack AI chat app (React + Vite + Tailwind frontend, Express backend) with OpenRouter and Tavily integrations.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
